intro.title: RTK Query — Data Fetching & Cache
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple React application that fetches and displays a list of posts from a mock API. You'll learn the core concept of data fetching and caching using RTK Query, a powerful data-fetching tool built into Redux Toolkit. The main technologies involved are React with TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, and the RTK Query API to define endpoints and manage server state. By the end, you'll understand how to set up an API service, fetch data, and automatically benefit from built-in caching and loading states, all while writing type-safe code.
intro.usecase: RTK Query is essential for building data-intensive React applications like e-commerce dashboards, social media feeds, and financial platforms. In these products, you'll see it managing cached product listings, real-time user notifications, and live stock price updates without redundant network requests. Developers use RTK Query to implement features like search filters that remember previous results, user profile panels that update across pages, and admin modals that fetch fresh data on demand. This pattern ensures smooth user experiences while optimizing performance through intelligent caching and automatic background refetching.
